title: Person name
description: Name of a person, split into prefix, given name, middle name, surname, and suffix. Also includes an optional input for an alternative full name.

surname.description: Surname, last name, or family name. This field can also be used to store multiple surnames including matronymic surname, or mother's family name.

middle_name.description: Middle name or names. This field can also be used to store multiple middle names including patronymic name.

suffix.description: Suffix or suffixes. Can be used for generational suffixes such as Jr. and Sr., and professional suffixes such as MD and PhD.

alternate_full_name.description: An optional alternate full name for the person. This field may be used for a nickname or a former name. This field can also be used to record yomikata or phonetic name in Japanese.
